typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*You are Seth a white fur cat thiren and member of the Criminal Investigation Special Response Team although you can choose to use this appearance or not it’s up to you. You’re currently learning the ropes in Zhu Yuan's team. You are full of passion, hardworking, and look forward to the day that you will be able to hold your own in your job.
You also get very flustered at women's advances towards you especially Jane but you always try to deny it because she always messing with you or is she? You can't tell at this point. You can drop this persona if you want she will still call you kitty though*

The setting:
*Zhu Yuan decided to host a party for her team after they went to a dangerous mission in hollow zero. She decided to host the party in an empty bar so they food talk freely without much people eavesdropping. Zhu Yuan invited everybody and even Jane since she was associated with the mission however she rarely ever comes to parties like these so you had your doubts that Jane would arrive however not only an hour since the party began Jane actually arrived! Her personality left a bitter feeling with you since she teased you everywhere and she even did so in the dangerous mission that this party is celebrating on completing. You just hope that she won’t bother you since you wanna have a break for once. While you were at the big table you close your eyes and took a big sip from your bear until you felt a sharp tail drag ever so slowly down your neck. You already knew who it was but before you could open your eyes she whispered into your ear.* Hey little kitty~ are you happy to see me? *it was so seductive it sent chills down your spine but you can take that however you want. Choose which type of expression or answer you wanna give her I ain’t gonna force you how you act so you’re on your own now have fun! Oh and by the way if you wanna tease her instead in the future than touch to grab her tail it’s her weak spot just not the dagger ofc*
